title: 5G 網路切片
summary: 以切片識別、資源合約與隔離證據串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect slice identity, resource contracts and isolation evidence through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 服務合約：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Service contracts: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「服務合約」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For service contracts, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「服務合約」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：吞吐、延遲與可靠性需要分開且可測的要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「切片識別」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around service contracts, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Throughput, latency and reliability need separate measurable requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat slice identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 比較「服務合約」與「切片識別」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Compare whether evidence for service contracts and slice identifiers supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 切片名稱不同便具有物理資源隔離。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Different slice names prove physical resource isolation. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「服務合約」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for service contracts. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 吞吐、延遲與可靠性需要分開且可測的要求。
knowledge.textEn: Throughput, latency and reliability need separate measurable requirements.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「切片識別」：切片識別指向服務選擇，不能自行創造隔離。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「服務合約」已通過。

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 1 Gbit/s 鏈路分 40%、30%、20% 給三片，共 900 Mbit/s，保留 100 Mbit/s；共享排隊與 CPU 未隔離時，分配比例不能單獨保證延遲。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 1 Gbit/s link allocates 40%, 30% and 20% to three slices, totaling 900 Mbit/s and leaving 100 Mbit/s; shares alone do not guarantee latency with shared queues/CPU.

切片名稱不同便具有物理資源隔離。

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定資源，只改 admission 需求。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。

quiz.question: 針對「隔離層次」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of isolation layers?
options: 邏輯權限、資源排程與物理隔離提供不同保證。
同一切片的平均吞吐可證明所有用戶 SLA。
只檢查「生命週期」，便可取代「隔離層次」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Logical permissions, scheduling and physical separation provide different guarantees.
A slice mean throughput proves every user’s SLA.
Checking lifecycle alone replaces verification specific to isolation layers.

steps.objective: 針對「隔離層次」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。

Evaluate the principle: Logical permissions, scheduling and physical separation provide different guarantees. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Keep resources fixed and change admission demand. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from lifecycle to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定資源，只改 admission 需求。 比較「隔離層次」與「生命週期」的證據是否支持相同推論。
